<code id="mt-out">shown=zone, river, bridges</code>

<script type="module">
  import { poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-elements';
  // Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
  const paper = (dark) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
  poadBasemaps().registerAll([
    { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
    { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
  ]);
  const bridge = (name, state, lng, lat) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
  document.querySelector('#mt-zone').data = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
  document.querySelector('#mt-river').data = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
  document.querySelector('#mt-bridges').data = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };
  const out = document.querySelector('#mt-out');
  const shown = new Set(['zone', 'river', 'bridges']);
  // `visiblechange` d'une couche (`detail` : visible), montrée ou masquée par la ligne
  document.querySelector('#mt').addEventListener('visiblechange', (e) => {
    if (e.detail) shown.add(e.target.id.slice(3)); else shown.delete(e.target.id.slice(3));
    out.textContent = `shown=${['zone', 'river', 'bridges'].filter((id) => shown.has(id)).join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  });
</script>

What it is for

It names a layer of the parent map (layer) and follows its name, visibility and symbology; the checkbox hides the layer and tells the application (two-way visible). A layer by category lists its symbols under the row. For several related layers, use the layer group; for a plain legend, the map legend.

Properties

booleanfalse“Zoom to layer” button.

Methods

MethodSignatureDescription
kindClass(k: string): stringSwatch class of a geometry (k-point…).

Keyboard

KeyEffect
TabReaches the checkbox, then “Zoom to layer”, “Opacity” and the slider once expanded.
SpaceOn the checkbox: shows or hides the layer.
Enter SpaceOn “Opacity”: expands or collapses the slider; on “Zoom to layer”: fits the map to the layer.
← →On the slider: 5 % less or more opacity.

Accessibility

  • The checkbox is named by the layer; clicking the name toggles it too. The “Zoom to layer” and “Opacity” buttons are named, their tooltip repeats the name.
  • “Opacity” says whether it is expanded (aria-expanded) and what it opens (aria-controls). The swatch and palette are decorative: the name carries the information.

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/map.css, @poadio/ui-core/slider.css, @poadio/ui-core/checkbox.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius-lg: 16px;        /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius-lg: 0;           /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadMapBasemapRegistry, PoadMapComponent, PoadMapLayerComponent, PoadMapLayerGroupComponent, PoadMapLayerToggleComponent, PoadMapPanelComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
const river = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
const zone = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
const bridge = (name: string, state: string, lng: number, lat: number) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
const bridges = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };

@Component({
  selector: 'app-map-layer-group-demo',
  imports: [PoadMapComponent, PoadMapLayerComponent, PoadMapPanelComponent, PoadMapLayerGroupComponent, PoadMapLayerToggleComponent],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-wide">
      <poad-map basemap="paper" [basemaps]="['paper', 'night']" followTheme [center]="[4.84, 45.76]" [zoom]="12" height="360px" [controls]="['zoom', 'scale']" ariaLabel="Bridges along the river">
        <poad-map-layer id="zone" label="Flood zone" [data]="zone" [(visible)]="showZone" [style]="{ fill: '#2f6feb', fillOpacity: 0.15, stroke: '#2f6feb', strokeWidth: 1 }" [interactive]="false" />
        <poad-map-layer id="river" label="River" [data]="river" [(visible)]="showRiver" [style]="{ stroke: '#0891b2', strokeWidth: 4 }" [interactive]="false" />
        <poad-map-layer id="bridges" label="Bridges" [data]="bridges" [(visible)]="showBridges"
          [style]="{ color: { field: 'state', categories: { good: '#1a7f37', fair: '#d29922', poor: '#cf222e' } }, radius: 8 }" />
        <poad-map-panel id="layers" header="Layers" icon="layers" side="right" [width]="260" [open]="true" [closable]="false">
          <div style="padding: 8px 12px">
            <poad-map-layer-group header="Water" [layers]="['river', 'zone']" zoomTo />
            <poad-map-layer-toggle layer="bridges" />
          </div>
        </poad-map-panel>
      </poad-map>
    </div>
    <code>shown={{ shown() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class MapLayerGroupDemo {
  readonly zone = zone;
  readonly river = river;
  readonly bridges = bridges;
  readonly showZone = signal(true);
  readonly showRiver = signal(true);
  readonly showBridges = signal(true);
  readonly shown = computed(() => [this.showZone() && 'zone', this.showRiver() && 'river', this.showBridges() && 'bridges'].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'none');
  constructor() {
    inject(PoadMapBasemapRegistry).registerAll([
      { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
      { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
    ]);
  }
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

Client component, like the map.

// app/map-layer-group-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadMap, PoadMapLayer, PoadMapLayerGroup, PoadMapLayerToggle, PoadMapPanel, poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-react';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
poadBasemaps().registerAll([
  { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
]);
const river = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
const zone = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
const bridge = (name: string, state: string, lng: number, lat: number) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
const bridges = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };
const center: [number, number] = [4.84, 45.76];
const controls = ['zoom', 'scale'] as const;

export default function MapLayerGroupDemo() {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState({ zone: true, river: true, bridges: true });
  const set = (id: keyof typeof shown) => (v: boolean) => setShown((s) => ({ ...s, [id]: v }));
  const list = (Object.keys(shown) as (keyof typeof shown)[]).filter((k) => shown[k]).join(', ') || 'none';
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-wide">
        <PoadMap basemap="paper" basemaps={['paper', 'night']} followTheme center={center} zoom={12} height="360px" controls={controls} ariaLabel="Bridges along the river">
          <PoadMapLayer id="zone" label="Flood zone" data={zone} visible={shown.zone} onVisibleChange={set('zone')} style={{ fill: '#2f6feb', fillOpacity: 0.15, stroke: '#2f6feb', strokeWidth: 1 }} interactive={false} />
          <PoadMapLayer id="river" label="River" data={river} visible={shown.river} onVisibleChange={set('river')} style={{ stroke: '#0891b2', strokeWidth: 4 }} interactive={false} />
          <PoadMapLayer id="bridges" label="Bridges" data={bridges} visible={shown.bridges} onVisibleChange={set('bridges')}
            style={{ color: { field: 'state', categories: { good: '#1a7f37', fair: '#d29922', poor: '#cf222e' } }, radius: 8 }} />
          <PoadMapPanel id="layers" header="Layers" icon="layers" side="right" width={260} open closable={false}>
            <div style={{ padding: '8px 12px' }}>
              <PoadMapLayerGroup header="Water" layers={['river', 'zone']} zoomTo />
              <PoadMapLayerToggle layer="bridges" />
            </div>
          </PoadMapPanel>
        </PoadMap>
      </div>
      <code>shown={list}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import MapLayerGroupDemo from './map-layer-group-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <MapLayerGroupDemo />;
}

  <poad-map id="mg" basemap="paper" basemaps='["paper","night"]' follow-theme center="[4.84,45.76]" zoom="12" height="360px" controls='["zoom","scale"]' aria-label="Bridges along the river">
    <poad-map-layer id="mg-zone" label="Flood zone" interactive="false" map-style='{"fill":"#2f6feb","fillOpacity":0.15,"stroke":"#2f6feb","strokeWidth":1}'></poad-map-layer>
    <poad-map-layer id="mg-river" label="River" interactive="false" map-style='{"stroke":"#0891b2","strokeWidth":4}'></poad-map-layer>

<code id="mg-out">shown=zone, river, bridges</code>

<script type="module">
  import { poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-elements';
  // Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
  const paper = (dark) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
  poadBasemaps().registerAll([
    { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
    { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
  ]);
  const bridge = (name, state, lng, lat) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
  document.querySelector('#mg-zone').data = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
  document.querySelector('#mg-river').data = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
  document.querySelector('#mg-bridges').data = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };
  const out = document.querySelector('#mg-out');
  const shown = new Set(['zone', 'river', 'bridges']);
  // `visiblechange` d'une couche (`detail` : visible), montrée ou masquée par la ligne
  document.querySelector('#mg').addEventListener('visiblechange', (e) => {
    if (e.detail) shown.add(e.target.id.slice(3)); else shown.delete(e.target.id.slice(3));
    out.textContent = `shown=${['zone', 'river', 'bridges'].filter((id) => shown.has(id)).join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  });
</script>

What it is for

layers names the group’s layers, in order. The group checkbox is checked when all are visible, “mixed” when some are; checking it shows them all, unchecking hides them all. Each row remains a layer toggle (checkbox, zoom, opacity).

Properties

NameTypeDefaultDescription
string—Group name (its checkbox, and the group’s name).
string[]—Ids of the group’s layers, in this order.
booleanfalse“Opacity” button on each row.
booleantrueSymbols of a layer by category, under the row (visible layer).
booleanfalse“Zoom to layer” button.

KeyEffect

Accessibility

  • The group is named by its header (role="group"); its checkbox states the partial state (aria-checked="mixed").
Stylesheets, theme tokens and texts stylesheets to import, 44 tokens, catalogue texts

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/map.css, @poadio/ui-core/slider.css, @poadio/ui-core/checkbox.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

// app/layout.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/map.css';             // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/slider.css';          // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/checkbox.css';        // this component
// main.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/map.css';             // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/slider.css';          // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/checkbox.css';        // this component
// main.ts

Theme tokens

Map layer group is tuned by 44 CSS --poad-* tokens. Change a token’s value in your application’s global stylesheet: the component follows, on every framework at once. Values: this site’s base theme, light and dark.

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius-lg: 16px;        /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius-lg: 0;           /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

Map legend

<poad-map-legend>

A map’s legend, placed in one of its corners: the layers, their symbols (solid colour, by category, graduated) in the language, and a toggle per layer to show or hide it, with the mouse as with the keyboard.

Angularrendered by @poadio/ui-angularNext.jsrendered by @poadio/ui-reactReactrendered by @poadio/ui-reactVuerendered by @poadio/ui-vueVanillarendered by @poadio/ui-elements

Your setting: :root { }

Live tweak, in the demo only: nothing is saved.

<poad-map-legend poadMapTopRight/> inside the map; [(visible)] on each <poad-map-layer>; [layers]: a list of layer components; the map also exposes layers() (a signal) and setLayerVisible(id).

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadMapBasemapRegistry, PoadMapComponent, PoadMapLayerComponent, PoadMapLegendComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
const river = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
const zone = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
const bridge = (name: string, state: string, lng: number, lat: number) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
const bridges = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };

@Component({
  selector: 'app-map-legend-demo',
  imports: [PoadMapComponent, PoadMapLayerComponent, PoadMapLegendComponent],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-wide">
      <poad-map basemap="paper" [basemaps]="['paper', 'night']" followTheme [center]="[4.84, 45.76]" [zoom]="12" height="360px"
        [controls]="['zoom', 'scale']" ariaLabel="Bridges along the river">
        <poad-map-legend poadMapTopRight title="Layers" />
        <poad-map-layer id="zone" label="Flood zone" [data]="zone" [(visible)]="showZone" [style]="{ fill: '#2f6feb', fillOpacity: 0.15, stroke: '#2f6feb', strokeWidth: 1 }" [interactive]="false" />
        <poad-map-layer id="river" label="River" [data]="river" [(visible)]="showRiver" [style]="{ stroke: '#0891b2', strokeWidth: 4 }" [interactive]="false" />
        <poad-map-layer id="bridges" label="Bridges" [data]="bridges" [(visible)]="showBridges"
          [style]="{ color: { field: 'state', categories: { good: '#1a7f37', fair: '#d29922', poor: '#cf222e' } }, radius: 8 }" />
      </poad-map>
    </div>
    <code>shown={{ shown() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class MapLegendDemo {
  readonly zone = zone;
  readonly river = river;
  readonly bridges = bridges;
  readonly showZone = signal(true);
  readonly showRiver = signal(true);
  readonly showBridges = signal(true);
  readonly shown = computed(() => [this.showZone() && 'Flood zone', this.showRiver() && 'River', this.showBridges() && 'Bridges'].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'none');
  constructor() {
    inject(PoadMapBasemapRegistry).registerAll([
      { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
      { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
    ]);
  }
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

A client component, like the map: the legend fills in once the map and its layers are mounted.

// app/map-legend-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadMap, PoadMapLayer, PoadMapLegend, poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-react';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
poadBasemaps().registerAll([
  { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
]);
const river = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
const zone = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
const bridge = (name: string, state: string, lng: number, lat: number) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
const bridges = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };
const center: [number, number] = [4.84, 45.76];
const controls = ['zoom', 'scale'] as const;

export default function MapLegendDemo() {
  const [showZone, setShowZone] = useState(true);
  const [showRiver, setShowRiver] = useState(true);
  const [showBridges, setShowBridges] = useState(true);
  const shown = [showZone && 'Flood zone', showRiver && 'River', showBridges && 'Bridges'].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'none';
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-wide">
        <PoadMap basemap="paper" basemaps={['paper', 'night']} followTheme center={center} zoom={12} height="360px" controls={controls}
          ariaLabel="Bridges along the river" topRight={<PoadMapLegend title="Layers" />}>
          <PoadMapLayer id="zone" label="Flood zone" data={zone} visible={showZone} onVisibleChange={setShowZone} style={{ fill: '#2f6feb', fillOpacity: 0.15, stroke: '#2f6feb', strokeWidth: 1 }} interactive={false} />
          <PoadMapLayer id="river" label="River" data={river} visible={showRiver} onVisibleChange={setShowRiver} style={{ stroke: '#0891b2', strokeWidth: 4 }} interactive={false} />
          <PoadMapLayer id="bridges" label="Bridges" data={bridges} visible={showBridges} onVisibleChange={setShowBridges}
            style={{ color: { field: 'state', categories: { good: '#1a7f37', fair: '#d29922', poor: '#cf222e' } }, radius: 8 }} />
        </PoadMap>
      </div>
      <code>shown={shown}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import MapLegendDemo from './map-legend-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <MapLegendDemo />;
}

  { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
]);
const river = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };

    { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
  ]);
  const bridge = (name, state, lng, lat) => ({ type: 'Feature', properties: { name, state }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat] } });
  document.querySelector('#ml-zone').data = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Flood zone' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.8, 45.73], [4.88, 45.74], [4.89, 45.785], [4.82, 45.78], [4.8, 45.73]]] } };
  document.querySelector('#ml-river').data = { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'River' }, geometry: { type: 'LineString', coordinates: [[4.78, 45.72], [4.81, 45.745], [4.835, 45.755], [4.84, 45.76], [4.86, 45.775], [4.9, 45.79]] } };
  document.querySelector('#ml-bridges').data = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [bridge('Bridge A', 'good', 4.84, 45.76), bridge('Bridge B', 'fair', 4.81, 45.745), bridge('Bridge C', 'poor', 4.86, 45.775), bridge('Bridge D', 'good', 4.79, 45.73)] };
  const layers = ['#ml-zone', '#ml-river', '#ml-bridges'].map((s) => document.querySelector(s));
  const out = document.querySelector('#ml-out');
  // `visiblechange` : l'utilisateur a montré ou masqué une couche dans la légende (la propriété `visible` suit)
  document.querySelector('#ml').addEventListener('visiblechange', () => {
    out.textContent = `shown=${layers.filter((l) => l.visible !== false).map((l) => l.label).join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  });
</script>

What it is for

It reads the parent map’s layers: nothing to pass, it follows additions, removals, names and symbology. A toggle hides the layer on the map and tells the application (two-way visible); when the application changes visible, the legend follows. toggleable false: a read-only legend that only shows the visible layers; items: a hand-written legend. For an exclusive choice between basemaps, a legend is not the tool: a basemap picker is.

Methods

<poad-map-legend>

MethodSignatureDescription
toggle(g: MapLegendGroup): voidShows or hides one of the legend’s layers.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
TabReaches the “Legend” header, then the list of layers (a single stop: the active layer).
↑ ↓In the list: previous layer, next layer (wrapping).
Home EndFirst, last layer.
Space EnterOn a layer: shows or hides it. On the header: collapses or expands the legend.

Accessibility

  • Each layer is a checkbox (role="checkbox", aria-checked) named by the layer; its symbols are listed below it, the swatch is only decorative.
  • The header is a button that says whether the legend is expanded (aria-expanded) and what it controls (aria-controls).
  • A hidden layer stays in the list, unchecked and dimmed: it can always be shown again. Focus is a solid accent ring (≥ 3:1 in light and dark).
Stylesheets, theme tokens and texts stylesheets to import, 39 tokens, catalogue texts

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/map.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius-lg: 16px;        /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius-lg: 0;           /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadMapBasemapRegistry, PoadMapComponent, PoadMapSearchComponent, mapLocalGeocoder, type PoadGeocodeResult } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
// Géocodeur local : une liste fermée de lieux, aucune requête réseau (sans `provider` : la Base Adresse Nationale).
const places = mapLocalGeocoder([
  { label: 'Pont Lafayette', lng: 4.8387, lat: 45.7625, context: 'Lyon 2e' },
  { label: 'Pont Wilson', lng: 4.8375, lat: 45.7585, context: 'Lyon 2e' },
  { label: 'Pont de la Guillotière', lng: 4.8378, lat: 45.7553, context: 'Lyon 7e' },
  { label: 'Passerelle Saint-Georges', lng: 4.8268, lat: 45.7579, context: 'Lyon 5e' },
  { label: 'Lyon', lng: 4.8357, lat: 45.764, type: 'municipality', context: 'Rhône' },
  { label: 'Villeurbanne', lng: 4.8799, lat: 45.7719, type: 'municipality', context: 'Rhône' },
], { delay: 150 });

@Component({
  selector: 'app-map-search-demo',
  imports: [PoadMapComponent, PoadMapSearchComponent],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-wide">
      <poad-map basemap="paper" [basemaps]="['paper', 'night']" followTheme [center]="[4.84, 45.76]" [zoom]="12" height="360px"
        [controls]="['zoom', 'scale']" controlPosition="bottom-right" ariaLabel="Lyon">
        <poad-map-search poadMapTopLeft [provider]="places" placeholder="Bridge or town…" ariaLabel="Search a place" (select)="picked.set($event.label)" (cleared)="picked.set('none')" />
      </poad-map>
    </div>
    <code>picked={{ picked() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class MapSearchDemo {
  readonly places = places;
  readonly picked = signal('none');
  constructor() {
    inject(PoadMapBasemapRegistry).registerAll([
      { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
      { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
    ]);
  }
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

A client component, like the map; the BAN is never called during server rendering.

// app/map-search-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadMap, PoadMapSearch, mapLocalGeocoder, poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-react';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
poadBasemaps().registerAll([
  { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
]);
// Géocodeur local, créé hors du rendu : une liste fermée de lieux, aucune requête réseau (sans `provider` : la BAN).
const places = mapLocalGeocoder([
  { label: 'Pont Lafayette', lng: 4.8387, lat: 45.7625, context: 'Lyon 2e' },
  { label: 'Pont Wilson', lng: 4.8375, lat: 45.7585, context: 'Lyon 2e' },
  { label: 'Pont de la Guillotière', lng: 4.8378, lat: 45.7553, context: 'Lyon 7e' },
  { label: 'Passerelle Saint-Georges', lng: 4.8268, lat: 45.7579, context: 'Lyon 5e' },
  { label: 'Lyon', lng: 4.8357, lat: 45.764, type: 'municipality', context: 'Rhône' },
  { label: 'Villeurbanne', lng: 4.8799, lat: 45.7719, type: 'municipality', context: 'Rhône' },
], { delay: 150 });
const center: [number, number] = [4.84, 45.76];
const controls = ['zoom', 'scale'] as const;

export default function MapSearchDemo() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState('none');
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-wide">
        <PoadMap basemap="paper" basemaps={['paper', 'night']} followTheme center={center} zoom={12} height="360px" controls={controls} controlPosition="bottom-right"
          ariaLabel="Lyon" topLeft={<PoadMapSearch provider={places} placeholder="Bridge or town…" ariaLabel="Search a place" onSelect={(r) => setPicked(r.label)} onClear={() => setPicked('none')} />} />
      </div>
      <code>picked={picked}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import MapSearchDemo from './map-search-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <MapSearchDemo />;
}

    controls='["zoom","scale"]' control-position="bottom-right" aria-label="Lyon">
    <poad-map-search id="ms-search" slot="top-left" placeholder="Bridge or town…" aria-label="Search a place"></poad-map-search>
  </poad-map>
</div>
<code id="ms-out">picked=none</code>

<script type="module">
  import { mapLocalGeocoder, poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-elements';
  // Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
  const paper = (dark) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
  poadBasemaps().registerAll([
    { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
    { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
  ]);
  const search = document.querySelector('#ms-search');
  const out = document.querySelector('#ms-out');
  // Géocodeur local (propriété `provider`) : une liste fermée de lieux, aucune requête réseau (sans lui : la BAN).
  search.provider = mapLocalGeocoder([
    { label: 'Pont Lafayette', lng: 4.8387, lat: 45.7625, context: 'Lyon 2e' },
    { label: 'Pont Wilson', lng: 4.8375, lat: 45.7585, context: 'Lyon 2e' },
    { label: 'Pont de la Guillotière', lng: 4.8378, lat: 45.7553, context: 'Lyon 7e' },
    { label: 'Passerelle Saint-Georges', lng: 4.8268, lat: 45.7579, context: 'Lyon 5e' },
    { label: 'Lyon', lng: 4.8357, lat: 45.764, type: 'municipality', context: 'Rhône' },
    { label: 'Villeurbanne', lng: 4.8799, lat: 45.7719, type: 'municipality', context: 'Rhône' },
  ], { delay: 150 });
  // `placeselect` : l'utilisateur a choisi un lieu ; `clear` : il a effacé la recherche
  search.addEventListener('placeselect', (e) => { out.textContent = `picked=${e.detail.label}`; });
  search.addEventListener('clear', () => { out.textContent = 'picked=none'; });
</script>

What it is for

The geocoder is replaceable: by default the French national address base (BAN, one network request per search), otherwise provider — an object with search(q, options). mapLocalGeocoder(places) searches a closed list without any network, as in this demo. Typing is debounced (debounce), a search starts at three characters (minChars), and a reply that arrives too late is dropped. On mobile, keep it alone in its corner: the list takes the field’s width. To filter the features of a layer that is already loaded, a geocoder is not the tool: a filter on the layer is.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
↓ ↑In the field: next, previous result (wrapping); ↓ reopens a closed list.
Home EndList open: first, last result.
EnterPicks the active result: the map flies there and pins it.
EscCloses the list; list closed: clears the search and the pin.
TabLeaves the field (the list closes), then reaches the “Clear” button.

Accessibility

  • The field is a named combobox (the prompt text by default, or ariaLabel); the list is a listbox linked by aria-controls, and the active result is pointed to by aria-activedescendant: focus stays in the field.
  • The number of results is announced (“3 results”, “No results”) through a role="status" region; waiting is shown by a decorative icon, without announcement.
  • The pin placed on the chosen place is named after it (role="img"); the “Clear” button removes it with the search, and gives focus back to the field.

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius-lg: 16px;        /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius-lg: 0;           /* Large rounding: cards, dialogs, panels */
}

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { PoadMapBasemapRegistry, PoadMapCardComponent, type PoadGeoJSON } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });

@Component({
  selector: 'app-map-card-demo',
  imports: [FormsModule, PoadMapCardComponent],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-wide"><poad-map-card [(ngModel)]="value" header="Study site" basemap="paper" [basemaps]="['paper', 'night']" followTheme height="360px" editable (flippedChange)="flipped.set($event)" /></div>
    <code>value={{ summary(value) }} flipped={{ flipped() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class MapCardDemo {
  value: PoadGeoJSON | string | null = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Site' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.82, 45.75], [4.85, 45.75], [4.85, 45.77], [4.82, 45.77], [4.82, 45.75]]] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Gauge' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [4.835, 45.76] } },
  ] };
  readonly flipped = signal(false);
  constructor() {
    inject(PoadMapBasemapRegistry).registerAll([
      { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
      { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
    ]);
  }
  summary(v: unknown): string { const g = v as { features?: unknown[] } | null; return g ? `${g.features?.length ?? 1} feature(s)` : 'empty'; }
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

Client component, like the map: the header renders on the server, the map and the editor come alive on mount.

// app/map-card-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadMapCard, poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-react';

// Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
const paper = (dark: boolean) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
poadBasemaps().registerAll([
  { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
  { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
]);
const site = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [
  { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Site' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.82, 45.75], [4.85, 45.75], [4.85, 45.77], [4.82, 45.77], [4.82, 45.75]]] } },
  { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Gauge' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [4.835, 45.76] } },
] };
const summary = (v: unknown) => { const g = v as { features?: unknown[] } | null; return g ? `${g.features?.length ?? 1} feature(s)` : 'empty'; };

export default function MapCardDemo() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<object | string | null>(site);
  const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-wide"><PoadMapCard value={value} onValueChange={setValue} header="Study site" basemap="paper" basemaps={['paper', 'night']} followTheme height="360px" editable onFlippedChange={setFlipped} /></div>
      <code>value={summary(value)} flipped={String(flipped)}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import MapCardDemo from './map-card-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <MapCardDemo />;
}

  import { poadBasemaps } from '@poadio/ui-elements';
  // Fonds locaux (aucune tuile distante) : un style MapLibre minimal, clair et sombre.
  const paper = (dark) => ({ version: 8, name: dark ? 'night' : 'paper', sources: {}, layers: [{ id: 'bg', type: 'background', paint: { 'background-color': dark ? '#151b24' : '#eef2f5' } }] });
  poadBasemaps().registerAll([
    { id: 'paper', label: 'Paper', kind: 'vector', style: paper(false) },
    { id: 'night', label: 'Night', kind: 'vector', style: paper(true), dark: true },
  ]);
  const card = document.querySelector('#card');
  card.value = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Site' }, geometry: { type: 'Polygon', coordinates: [[[4.82, 45.75], [4.85, 45.75], [4.85, 45.77], [4.82, 45.77], [4.82, 45.75]]] } },
    { type: 'Feature', properties: { name: 'Gauge' }, geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [4.835, 45.76] } },
  ] };
  const out = { value: '2 feature(s)', flipped: false };
  const show = () => { document.querySelector('#card-out').textContent = `value=${out.value} flipped=${out.flipped}`; };
  card.addEventListener('change', (e) => { const g = e.detail; out.value = g ? `${g.features?.length ?? 1} feature(s)` : 'empty'; show(); });
  card.addEventListener('flippedchange', (e) => { out.flipped = e.detail; show(); });
</script>

What it is for

The value is a GeoJSON object (FeatureCollection, Feature or geometry) or, in string mode, its JSON text. The map fits the value. editable adds a drawing bar (point, line, polygon, select, delete); each drawn shape returns a new value. The GeoJSON button flips the card: the editor checks the JSON then the GeoJSON (coordinates, closed rings) with messages from the catalogue; “Apply” returns the value, “Cancel” or Escape go back to the map. Read-only, the back shows the GeoJSON without changing it.

MethodSignatureDescription

Keyboard

KeyEffect
← → Home EndIn the drawing bar: previous, next, first, last tool (disabled buttons skipped).
SpaceOn the map, while drawing: places a point at the centre (as with the map tools).
EnterOn a button: activates it (tool, basemaps, flip, apply).
EscOn the back: goes back to the map without changing anything.

Accessibility

  • The hidden side is inert: nothing there takes focus or is read. On flipping, focus moves to the editor; on the way back, it returns to the GeoJSON button.
  • Buttons named in the language; the basemap picker tells its state (aria-expanded); the drawing bar is a named toolbar, a single tab stop, aria-pressed on the tools.
  • Theme: followTheme (as on the map) picks the light or dark basemap among basemaps from the page theme, and follows it when it changes; a basemap the user picks wins.
  • The editor is a named field, described by its error message; no animation when the user declines it (prefers-reduced-motion).

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/map.css, @poadio/ui-core/json-editor.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

// app/layout.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet

import '@poadio/ui-core/json-editor.css';     // this component

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius: 0;              /* Corner rounding of controls */
}
